title: Temple of Augustus
visualBrief: Specific standing Temple of Augustus in Pula: narrow rectangular rubble-stone cella, six smooth grey Corinthian columns (four front and two side), engaged antae, a true deep portico, recessed timber cella door, raised stone podium/centered stairs with cheeks, layered entablature, plain triangular pediment and projecting dentil/modillion cornices, simple tiled gable roof and open-column timber ceiling. Adjacent City Hall and independent urban buildings remain host context. No complete museum interior, copied readable inscription or narrative sculpture.
